description: This file contains unit tests for the ExpressionResolver class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.placeholders package. It tests various placeholder resolution scenarios, including default values, string operations, and deletion logic.

classes.name: ExpressionResolverTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the ExpressionResolver class under various placeholder resolution scenarios.

methods.name: setupExpressionResolver
methods.description: Initializes the ExpressionResolver instance with predefined placeholder resolvers and test data before each test.

methods.name: testPlaceholderFunctionDefaultWithConstant
methods.description: Tests that the resolver correctly applies a default value when a header placeholder does not exist.

methods.name: testHeaderWithColon
methods.description: Checks that headers with colon characters are correctly resolved.

methods.name: testPlaceholderFunctionDefaultWithPlaceholder
methods.description: Verifies default value fallback using another placeholder.

methods.name: testPlaceholderFunctionDefaultWithPlaceholderNonExistingDefault
methods.description: Ensures that a default fallback placeholder that does not exist results in an empty string.

methods.name: testPlaceholderFunctionSubstringBefore
methods.description: Tests substring-before function extraction and concatenation with namespace.

methods.name: testPlaceholderFunctionSubstringBeforeWithDefaultFallback
methods.description: Verifies fallback to the full name when substring-before default is used with a non-matching delimiter.

methods.name: testPlaceholderFunctionSubstringAfterWithUpper
methods.description: Tests substring-after function combined with upper casing.

methods.name: testLoneDelete
methods.description: Checks that a delete function results in a specific deleted pipeline element.

methods.name: testLoneDefault
methods.description: Verifies that default placeholder resolution works correctly.

methods.name: testPipelineStartingWithDefault
methods.description: Tests a pipeline starting with a default function followed by an upper-casing function.

methods.name: testDeleteIfUnresolved
methods.description: Ensures that unresolved placeholders and delete functions produce correct delete or unresolved pipeline elements.
